lines.en: Would you like to come to my birthday party on Friday?
Thank you for inviting me. I would love to come.
I'm sorry, I can't come because I have to work.
Are you free this weekend? Let's have lunch together.
What time should I be there?
Can I bring a friend with me?
We are having a small dinner at our place tonight.
It was very kind of you to invite us.
Maybe next time. I hope you have a great time.
Please let me know if you can make it.
